summary: The meeting covered venue capacity (60 seats) and registration setup, proposing to use Firebase for registrations. The team agreed to use React for the frontend and host it on Vercel, and also agreed not to add a login page this week. Rahul will finish the API and push it to GitHub by Friday, enabling registrations once ready. Sneha will create the poster by Wednesday and someone will check the hall's Wi‑Fi. The decision on giving prizes in cash or vouchers is still open for the next meeting.
